info.title: CAP-005 Compliance API — CHAPS Sanctions Screening (JRN-028)
info.description: CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory) does not expose a new REST API surface for JRN-028. Sanctions screening is orchestrated by SVC-014 (KYC/AML Service) in response to CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated (EVT-108) via the Event Bus — no synchronous channel call to CAP-005. This document captures the existing CAP-005 API endpoints relevant to CHAPS payment compliance context and confirms no new endpoints are required for JRN-028.
info.x-note: No new CAP-005 API endpoints introduced by JRN-028. SVC-014 participates in JRN-028 via async event consumption only (EVT-108 consumed, EVT-P02 / EVT-006 published). Internal SVC-014 → SVC-051 call is intra-capability and not surfaced in the API contract.
